description: Delete a conversation with a candidate. Accepts room_name or talent_slug. The conversation and all its messages are deleted for everyone in it, including the candidate, and this can't be undone. Deleting takes two calls: without confirm_token nothing is deleted, and the reply shows the conversation with a confirm_token; calling again with the same room_name or talent_slug and that token deletes it. Show the user the conversation and get their OK before the second call. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

confirm_token.description: Leave out to see what would be deleted; nothing is deleted. Pass the token from that reply to delete it

talent_slug.description: Talent slug (from search_talent results) — resolves to room name automatically

name: delete_conversation
title: Delete employer conversation
